result:
T-DG6-BE-RG2 is finished: all four findings (F-DG6-960, 970, 980 and 971) are fixed, and every required check passed. One integration run failed on a mistake in my own new test before I fixed it; details are under Checks. Changes are uncommitted on `dg6/be-rg2`. `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG5` exited 0 at the start and at the end. I ran from 21:24:09Z to 22:06:30Z.

**F-DG6-960/970/980: a withheld answer reached the model again.** I fixed it two ways:
- **History is re-checked before the model call.** `historyFor` in `conversations.ts` (it replaces `historyOf`) runs the same readability check on each earlier answer as the conversation view does, for the caller at request time. Answers stored before 0128 are checked by their citations. A withheld answer is **dropped** from the history, not replaced. A placeholder would be text the model never wrote, and it would still reveal that an answer on that subject existed. The user's own prompts stay in the history.
- **New answers inherit the history's records.** A new answer's stored `context_records` is its own records followed by the records of every earlier answer it was given. This carries forward turn after turn, so a later revocation withholds the new answer and its suggestions too.
- **Cap raised from 20 to 1,000 in migration 0129.** 1,000 is the most one conversation can produce: at most 50 answers, each given at most 20 records. So the stored list is never cut short. I rejected "store a bounded list and withhold when cut", because it would hide readable answers in long conversations for no security gain. As a guard in case those limits change, the API drops the oldest history answers whose records wouldn't fit.
- **Other paths:** none. `answer.ts` is the only caller of `ModelProvider.complete`, and suggestions store the answer's full record list.

**F-DG6-971: suggestions stored before 0128 couldn't be taken to a draft.** Migration 0129 (`0129_p6_assistant_context_insert_rule.sql`) replaces both NOT VALID CHECKs with insert-only triggers of the same names, raising the same error code 23514. New rows without a record list are still refused at INSERT, and old rows can be updated. `assistant_message` got the same change so both tables use one mechanism.

**Tests:** new suite `apps/api/test/integration/assistant/history-recheck.test.ts` (shipped `http_endpoint` provider, a fake model that repeats its last answer from the history). It has 5 cases: the reviewers' sequence, the inheritance (including a third turn), an old history answer, an old suggestion taken to a draft (200), and new rows refused without a record list. Before the fix all 5 fail; after it, they and the 5 RG1 cases in `context-recheck.test.ts` pass (10/10).

**Checks:**
- **Static:** `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, the prettier check and `pnpm openapi:lint` all exited 0.
- **Unit:** `pnpm test` exited 0 with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8: 2906, 2113 and 259 tests passed. The 2 skipped are in `fuzz.test.ts`, which I didn't touch.
- **Integration:** all assistant files, the catalogue and migrate tests, and `contract.test.ts` passed in both locales, 290/290 across 14 files.
- **The failed run:** the first integration run exited 1 on my new 0129 catalogue test, which used `risk`, not a valid search record type. I switched it to `benefit` and all later runs passed.
- **A bad command:** my first OpenAPI lint attempt was mis-split by my shell loop and ran the wrong command (exit 254). The real `pnpm openapi:lint` exited 0 right after.

**Reviewers' probes on the fixed tree:**
- **QA probe:** passes.
- **Code-security history probe:** fails, as expected, since it asserts the defect. Its log confirms the request no longer carries the withheld text. The program-two title still in its final output comes from text hard-coded in the probe's own fake, not from the product.
- **Code-security legacy-suggestion probe:** its control case passes. Its main case fails in its own setup, because it drops the CHECK that 0129 removed; my case 4 covers the same scenario and passes.
- **Domain probe:** not re-run. It is appended to `context-recheck.test.ts`, whose setup I changed; its sequence is covered by case 1 and the QA probe.

**Other changes:**
- **Docs:** ADR-0059 §5 and §9 are amended, with a new RG2 amendment section. The data dictionary has a 0129 section built from real catalogue output. OpenAPI changes are descriptions only.
- **Tests:** in the RG1 test I changed only the case-5 setup DDL, because it dropped the old CHECK; no assertion changed. The catalogue test now covers 0129.
- **Contract:** no API operations were added, removed or routed, and there is no new dependency.

**For the orchestrator:**
- **Migration id:** renumber 0129 if another task takes that id first.
- **Not inherited:** answers stored between 0128 and 0129 don't carry their history's records. The history re-check still stops their withheld text reaching the model; the data dictionary says so.
- **Web comment:** `AssistantOutput.tsx:8` still says "a cited record". It is not user-facing and is outside my scope, so it's listed for the web owner.

The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-RG2-backend-workflow-engineer.md`, with logs under `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG6/T-DG6-BE-RG2-evidence/`.
